name: Pyke
description: Seat of House Greyjoy — towers on sea-battered stacks joined by swaying rope bridges. Theon came home to it, Balon was thrown from its bridge by Euron, and the kingsmoot on its shores gave Euron the Salt Throne.

name: Pebbleton
description: Fishing town on Great Wyk, largest of the Iron Islands. Book background; it is never visited in the show.

name: Hammerhorn
description: Grim inland keep of House Goodbrother on Great Wyk, hewn from the hills above the iron mines. Book background only.

name: Nagga's Ribs
description: The bones of the sea dragon Nagga on the holy headland of Old Wyk, where the ironborn of legend crowned their kings. The show's kingsmoot draws on this tradition, though the site itself is never shown.

name: Castle Goodbrother
description: A lesser Goodbrother holdfast in the Iron Islands. Book background; never seen or named on screen.

name: Ten Towers
description: Seat of House Harlaw on Harlaw, the most populous of the isles — ten mismatched towers raised over generations. Home of Rodrik the Reader in the books; unseen in the show.
